title: MWS 8-year resurvey — Anthropometric
description: Weight and BMI at the 8-year resurvey.

F2WGT.title: Weight now
F2WGT.$comment: Source states no valid range for this field. 35-195 reuses resurvey_3yr's already-confirmed F1WGT bound (D064's category) rather than re-deriving a fresh one, for consistency across the same measurement type -- note recruitment's RWGT used a narrower stated range (35-150), transcribed as its own source stated, not reconciled.

F2BMI.title: Body mass index
F2BMI.$comment: Source states no valid range; 10-80 reuses recruitment's RBMI bound (D018) and resurvey_3yr's F1BMI bound (D064), for consistency across all three tables rather than re-deriving a fresh one.
